observed_false_write_2.utterance: Do you think I like curry?

problem_evidence.interpretation: Preference regexes search anywhere in the utterance, so syntactic matching is mistaken for a direct user assertion. Persisting V67 metadata before fixing this boundary would preserve false memories more reliably.

causal_hypothesis: With the same existing profile extractor, utterances, case order, scorer, and no model inference, a generic assertion-scope guard will reject facts found only in questions, quotations, reported speech, or third-person preference statements while preserving direct user assertions. It will achieve at least 23 of 24 exact cases, zero false writes across all 12 non-assertions, exact recall on all 12 direct assertions, at least 8 newly exact cases versus the unguarded extractor, zero regressions, and less than 1 millisecond median overhead.
causal_boundary: This pilot tests only whether already extracted profile facts belong to a direct user assertion. It does not test open-domain fact extraction, coreference, persistence, state metadata, Chroma retrieval, working-memory validity, final replies, or broad human likeness.

conditions.assertion_scope_guard_treatment: The same extractor output filtered only by a generic direct-assertion scope decision.

only_changed_component: whether extracted facts must pass a direct user profile assertion scope guard

decision_rule.all_gates_pass: Authorize a separate integration PR that places the guard inside production profile extraction and reruns existing memory and dialogue regression tests.
decision_rule.any_gate_fails: Freeze the result and do not persist typed profile state. Diagnose whether the guard loses direct assertions or still accepts non-assertions.
decision_rule.stateful_writer: Not authorized until this assertion boundary passes and production integration remains regression-safe.

stop_conditions: Stop on dirty tracked tree, artifact drift, prior-text overlap, or expected-fact leakage into the guard.
Do not change utterances, expected facts, families, gates, or language labels after implementation begins.
Do not include case IDs, complete case utterances, or expected values in the guard.
Do not claim persistent-memory or full-dialogue improvement from this component pilot.
